rationale: Small business owners and freelance SEO practitioners already spend $99–129/month on Ahrefs and SEMrush, proving this segment pays for SEO diagnostic tools — willingness_to_pay is solid. The buyer is a nameable role (site owner or freelance SEO consultant managing 1–10 client sites) with clear budget authority and a recurring, stressful problem. The service can be built as a Claude-powered analysis prompt + automated Google Search Console data pull + email alert, making it genuinely buildable and largely autonomous. Total just misses the 6.5 build threshold; validate first to confirm conversion before committing to build.
solution_plan: The micro-service is a weekly SEO ranking-displacement monitor: it watches a client's Google Search Console data, detects when a landing page loses rankings to the homepage (keyword cannibalization), and emails a plain-English diagnosis with 2–3 actionable fixes generated by Claude. BUILD: the factory sets up a Google Search Console API integration (standard OAuth), a Claude prompt that interprets ranking signals, a simple intake form (site URL + GSC auth + email), and a Stripe payment link ($29–49/month). No coding by the operator. SELL: outreach goes to freelance SEO consultants and small business owners via LinkedIn and niche SEO communities (e.g. Traffic Think Tank Slack, r/SEO); the factory drafts and queues all outreach emails for operator approval before sending. MAINTAIN: weekly automated checks, Claude-generated email reports, and Stripe billing all run hands-off; the only recurring human touch is approving the outreach batch and any refund requests. VALIDATE FIRST: before building, send 20 cold emails to freelance SEO consultants offering a free 30-day trial in exchange for feedback — if 3+ convert to paid, build it.
notes: Total 6.4 is just below min_total_to_build (6.5); validate threshold met (5.5). All build gates would be met (operational_autonomy 7 ✓, buildability_with_ai 8 ✓, buyer_clarity 7 ✓, willingness_to_pay 7 ✓) — one strong validation response could push this to build. responsiveness_signal (2) is the key unknown to resolve.
